thesis.infer: Price recovered into the band between the True Market Mean and the ETF cost basis without crowding in funding, while HL OI rose to z30 2.17; we read it as positioning built ahead of FOMC rather than forced covering. Consensus is pricing a calm regime (VIX 17.52); we read the risk as a hawkish surprise meeting a 5% 10Y and thin liquidity.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds between $79.5K and $81.7K through FOMC; a daily close above $81.7K with realized cap growing would confirm recovery per hl-cycles. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.5K, the stated invalidation, puts the STH cost basis ($74.9K) in play, more likely on a hawkish surprise. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold lifts weak-structure alts off their 1d lows; risk skews to a sharp two-way move given OI near its 30d high.
